rows.text: Charged $14.99 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.
rows.quote: Renewed halcyonthreshold.org for 1 year** ($14.99, Nomiq Domains, card ending 4417)

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you, this is genuinely appreciated. Halcyon Threshold is early, and the most useful help right now is careful analysis. If you're willing, a good first project would be a short review of publicly available data on how frontier AI capabilities and compute have grown, with the sources cited, so we can ground our public writing in verifiable numbers. Tell me roughly what you'd want to take on and I'll make sure it gets scoped properly. Thanks again, Morgan's assistant, on behalf of Morgan Hale Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman** (who offered to volunteer) and asked her to start with a sourced review of public data on frontier AI compute and capability growth. I signed it as your assistant on your behalf.

rows.text: Published the public website at halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app.
rows.quote: Published a minimal landing page** at https://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app.
